Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii financiare și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Ready to take your career global?
 Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our ever-evolving Access team and help shape the future of global commerce.
 What You’ll Own
 You will collaborate with your cross-functional squad to design, develop, operate and improve the products our customers enjoy using. You will work with the wider engineering team to bring solutions to challenges that require cross squad collaboration. As a member of the squad, you will also have deep understanding of the product and industry you are building for.
Main Duties and Responsibilities:
Collaboratively develop the features and engineering capabilities for the products your squad own. We aim to employ automation for everything
Collaborate in all stages of development from requirement discussions with the Product Owner to the deployment of the feature in the cloud
Join the on-call rota to support the highly available products developed by the squad
Provide your squad with the tools to enable data driven decision making
Supporting and mentoring more junior engineers within the squad
Collaborate with your fellow engineers from other squads to make decisions around technologies, patterns and approaches to adopt
 What You’ll Bring
At least two years’ experience using design and implementation best practices for the development of web applications that are user friendly and easy to maintain.
Experience building web applications with Node, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and web application frameworks.
Experience with browser testing tools like browser-stack.
Experience with Test Driven Development.
Experience provisioning infrastructure in AWS.
An engineering skillset that is focused on quality and a test first philosophy, regardless of the activity.
An agile mindset where you will drive both your squad and the wider tribe towards better ways of working.
An inquisitive personality that is always looking for constant improvement opportunity.
 It’s a bonus if you have
Experience setting up CI/CD pipelines
Experience with Terraform
Experience with Redux, Scully, Cypress or Nest.js
Exposure to the Payments industry domain (especially Cards and other payment schemes)
Exposure to PCI-DSS
 About The Team
 Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.
 What makes a Globalpayer?
 Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.
